summary: A Yes vote makes Portola Valley a charter town and enacts a real property transfer tax of $10 per $1,000 of a property's sale price.

tax.text: A Yes vote establishes a real property transfer tax to provide revenue for municipal services.
tax.quote: If approved, Measure N would establish a tax of $10 per $1,000 of a property’s sale price.

tax.text: A No vote does not establish the proposed real property transfer tax.
